speed.max.why: the simulated base's rated top speed, forwards or backwards

yaw_rate.max.why: the fastest turn the base is rated for

accel.max.why: the change from the measured speed, over the command's duration

duration.max.why: a motion runs at most this long before it is checked again

workspace.why: the area the robot may be in: x min, x max, y min, y max (its whole body); inside the 9 m room with 0.1 m to spare

clearance.min.why: the smallest predicted gap between the robot's edge and an obstacle's

motor_temp.max.why: no motion while the motor is hotter than this

battery.min.why: no motion below this voltage (a 3S pack near empty)

state.max_age.why: every required reading must have arrived this recently

state.min_confidence.why: the lowest confidence a required reading may have

always.action.valid: the motion is a well-formed robot.action with finite numbers
always.e_stop: while the emergency stop is set, nothing but STOP
always.state.complete: every required quantity has a reading: an unknown is never taken as safe
